reason: Method relies on discretionary intraday order book activity, stocks in play with catalysts, and momentum; goes home flat daily with no daily-bar rules.

universe.description: Australian equities with catalysts like news or broker upgrades

setup.rule: Build stocks in play list using catalysts
setup.quote: every morning uh I'm building a list um where I'm basically looking to trade stocks that have a catalyst

entry.rule: Time entry using order book walls and activity
entry.quote: often times you can you can play a breakout and predict that wall breaking if you see a lot of activity coming up to the wall

stop.rule: Use bids in order book for exit if trade fails immediately
stop.quote: if I if I put a trade on doesn't go in the in my favor straight away then there's a good chance that it's it's probably not a winner

exits.quote: I try and go home as close to Flat as possible every day

sizing.rule: Position size based on visible bids for liquidity
sizing.quote: the volume or the size of the bids below is going to help me determine um my position size in terms of risk management

ambiguities.issue: Australian market focus and shorting mentioned
ambiguities.assumption: Core intraday order book approach is the main method
